marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech AI Capex & Cloud Monetization
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech leaders reported accelerated cloud revenue growth driven by enterprise AI workloads, alongside upward revisions to enterprise capital expenditure guidance for hardware infrastructure.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained demand for AI infrastructure supports valuation multiples for semiconductor suppliers and cloud platform providers, though elevated capex raises near-term margin pressure concerns.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of enterprise AI applications relative to capital expenditure intensity.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & Platform Economy Rebound
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw increased buying momentum supported by strong net inflows from Southbound Stock Connect, focusing primarily on e-commerce and digital gaming majors.
marketLayer.inference: Valuation discounts in HK-listed tech shares combined with stabilizing Chinese macroeconomic policy guidance are attracting long-term domestic institutional capital.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of consumer spending recovery in Mainland China and external trade policy developments.

marketLayer.title: US Rate Cut Expectations & Dollar Index Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Cooling inflation prints and stabilizing US labor market data reinforced market expectations for monetary policy easing by the Federal Reserve later this year.
marketLayer.inference: Lower Treasury yield trajectories improve risk appetite across equity markets, reducing cost of capital pressures for high-growth tech stocks and emerging market assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential commodity price resurgence and subsequent inflation stickiness.
